title: Access Management Policy
definition: Define a process for creating and documenting roles and responsibilities for each of the organization's workforce members.

title: Access Management Policy
definition: Ensure that documented roles and responsibilities for workforce members consider the principle of separation of duties when defining roles.

title: Access Management Policy
definition: Maintain documented Access Control Lists (ACLs) for each computing system and business application system.

title: Access Management Policy
definition: Ensure that documented ACLs for computing systems and business applications are based on the organization's defined roles for workforce members.

title: Access Management Policy
definition: Maintain ACLs on computing system objects based on approved documentation, roles, and the principle of least privilege.

title: Access Management Policy
definition: Maintain ACLs on computing system functions based on approved documentation, roles, and the principle of least privilege.

title: Access Management Policy
definition: Maintain ACLs on code repositories based on approved documentation, roles, and the principle of least privilege.

title: Access Management Policy
definition: Ensure that ACLs enforce encryption of data at rest on each of the organization's computing systems.

title: Access Management Policy
definition: Ensure that ACLs enforce data encryption in transit on each computing system.

title: Access Management Policy
definition: Define a process for reviewing the organization's documented ACLs on a regular basis.

title: Access Management Policy
definition: Define a process for reviewing the organization's ACL documentation on a regular basis.

title: Access Management Policy
category: AM-12 Group or Role Membership Review
definition: Define a process to regularly review the group or role membership used by the organization's ACLs.

title: Access Management Policy
category: AM-13 ACL Change Logging and Alerting
definition: Ensure the organization's information systems log and alert changes to group or role memberships or configured ACLs.
